metadata.description: Deploys an Azure Monitor Workbook that identifies observed Microsoft Entra SMS and voice authentication use from SigninLogs.
metadata.author: Nobufumi Murata

metadata.description: Subscription ID containing the Log Analytics workspace.
Resource group containing the Log Analytics workspace.
Existing Log Analytics workspace receiving Microsoft Entra SigninLogs.

workbookDisplayName.defaultValue: Entra SMS and Voice Retirement Readiness

content.json:
# Entra SMS / Voice Retirement Readiness
Microsoft-provided SMS and voice delivery retires on **2027-02-01**. This workbook shows observed authentication use from `SigninLogs`.

> **Interpretation:** observed use, registered phone methods, and Authentication Methods Policy scope are different populations. Use the Microsoft `entra-sms-voice-usage-analyzer` together with this workbook to collect current SMS / Voice policy state and target scope. `Passwordless phone sign-in` is not counted as SMS / voice.

parameters.name: AuthenticationMethod
parameters.label: Authentication method posture filter
parameters.description: Applies to the posture pie and bar charts. Previously satisfied is excluded by default.
parameters.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-expand Auth=todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend AuthMethod=tostring(Auth.authenticationMethod), AuthTime=todatetime(Auth.authenticationStepDateTime)
| where isnotempty(AuthMethod)
| extend StepAnchor=iff(isnull(AuthTime),Id,tostring(AuthTime))
| extend StepKey=strcat(UserId,"|",AuthMethod,"|",StepAnchor)
| summarize UniqueSteps=dcount(StepKey) by AuthMethod
| order by UniqueSteps desc
| project value=AuthMethod, label=strcat(AuthMethod," (",UniqueSteps,")"), selected=AuthMethod !~ "Previously satisfied"

content.query:
let TelephonyMethods=dynamic(["SMS","Voice","Text message","Phone call","Voice call"]);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-expand Auth=todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend AuthMethod=tostring(Auth.authenticationMethod), AuthSucceeded=tobool(Auth.succeeded), AuthTime=todatetime(Auth.authenticationStepDateTime), StepDetail=tostring(Auth.authenticationStepResultDetail)
| where AuthMethod in~ (TelephonyMethods)
| extend StepAnchor=iff(isnull(AuthTime),Id,tostring(AuthTime))
| extend StepKey=strcat(UserId,"|",AuthMethod,"|",StepAnchor)
| as Telephony
| union (Telephony | summarize Value=dcount(UserId) | extend Metric="Observed users", Detail="Unique users"), (Telephony | summarize Value=dcount(StepKey) | extend Metric="Unique steps", Detail="Deduplicated authentication steps"), (Telephony | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="Log rows", Detail="SigninLogs rows before deduplication"), (Telephony | summarize Value=dcountif(StepKey,AuthSucceeded == true) | extend Metric="Successful steps", Detail="Unique successful steps"), (Telephony | summarize Value=dcountif(StepKey,AuthSucceeded == false) | extend Metric="Failed steps", Detail="Unique failed steps")
| where isnotempty(Metric)
| project Metric,Value,Detail
content.title: Readiness summary
content.noDataMessage: No matching data in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Data quality
One authentication step can be copied to multiple resource sign-in rows. Use the distinct step key (`UserId + method + authenticationStepDateTime`) instead of raw row count.

content.query:
let TelephonyMethods=dynamic(["SMS","Voice","Text message","Phone call","Voice call"]);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-expand Auth=todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend AuthMethod=tostring(Auth.authenticationMethod), AuthSucceeded=tobool(Auth.succeeded), AuthTime=todatetime(Auth.authenticationStepDateTime), StepDetail=tostring(Auth.authenticationStepResultDetail)
| where AuthMethod in~ (TelephonyMethods)
| extend StepAnchor=iff(isnull(AuthTime),Id,tostring(AuthTime))
| extend StepKey=strcat(UserId,"|",AuthMethod,"|",StepAnchor)
| summarize LogRows=count(), SignInIds=dcount(Id), UniqueSteps=dcount(StepKey), DuplicateRows=count()-dcount(StepKey), FirstSeen=min(AuthTime), LastSeen=max(AuthTime) by AuthMethod
| order by UniqueSteps desc
content.title: Raw rows versus unique authentication steps
content.noDataMessage: No matching data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let Observed=SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-expand Auth=todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend AuthMethod=tostring(Auth.authenticationMethod), AuthTime=todatetime(Auth.authenticationStepDateTime)
| where isnotempty(AuthMethod)
| where "{AuthenticationMethod:label}" == "All" or AuthMethod in ({AuthenticationMethod})
| extend StepAnchor=iff(isnull(AuthTime),Id,tostring(AuthTime))
| extend StepKey=strcat(UserId,"|",AuthMethod,"|",StepAnchor), MethodCategory=case(AuthMethod in~ ("Text message","SMS"), "SMS", AuthMethod in~ ("Voice","Phone call","Voice call"), "Voice", "Other")
| summarize UniqueSteps=dcount(StepKey) by MethodCategory;
datatable(MethodCategory:string) ["SMS","Voice","Other"]
| join kind=leftouter Observed on MethodCategory
| project MethodCategory,UniqueSteps=coalesce(UniqueSteps,tolong(0))
| order by UniqueSteps desc
content.title: SMS / Voice share of all authentication steps
content.noDataMessage: No matching data in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Limitations and next actions
- This workbook is log-based and shows observed authentication events, not current Authentication Methods Policy scope.
- Run the Microsoft `entra-sms-voice-usage-analyzer` to obtain current SMS / Voice policy state, include / exclude targets, registration campaign state, and target CSV.
- Compare the analyzer target CSV with the Observed users table before changing policy or contacting users.
- Use Entra Authentication Methods Activity when registered-method capability must also be confirmed.
- The workbook never displays phone numbers, OTP values, tokens, or client secrets.
